steps.hardClue: Place the amulet on the stone pedestal to open the portal.
steps.clue: Place the amulet on the Temple pedestal to open the Dark Aether Nexus.

steps.hardClue: Collect three weapon parts from a special enemy and two mural lockdowns.
steps.clue: Collect the Monocle and complete the Bull and Hunter mural lockdowns to obtain the Staff parts.

steps.hardClue: Defend the Wonder Weapon while it is constructed in the alternate dimension.
steps.clue: Defend the Staff of Ice during its construction in the Dark Aether Nexus.

steps.hardClue: Freeze three lanterns within ten seconds.
steps.clue: Freeze three Dark Aether Lanterns with the Staff of Ice within ten seconds.

steps.hardClue: Lower three marked rocks, then shoot their symbols on the blocked gateway.
steps.clue: Lower three symbol rocks with the Staff of Ice, then shoot their symbols on the blocked Gateway.

steps.hardClue: Escort the purple orb and fill it with souls to upgrade the weapon.
steps.clue: Escort the purple orb through the Dark Aether Nexus to upgrade the Staff of Ice.

steps.hardClue: Complete the crawling and flying creature statue trials and return their energy.
steps.clue: Complete the Vermin and Parasite statue trials and return their Amulet Energy to the Nexus.

steps.hardClue: Complete the special and elite creature statue trials and return their energy.
steps.clue: Complete the Doppelghast and Amalgam statue trials and return their Amulet Energy to the Nexus.

steps.hardClue: Cross the bridge and defeat the spinning laser boss.
steps.clue: Cross the opened bridge and defeat the Sentinel Artifact.
